# Krishnendu Biswas

Krishnendu Biswas is a Data and AI systems builder based in India. He is an MBA candidate at the Indian Institute of Management (IIM) Ranchi, holds a Diploma in Programming from the Indian Institute of Technology (IIT) Madras BS program, and is a Springer-published researcher.

## Core Expertise
- AI Agent Platforms & Orchestration: Hermes Agent, Multi-Profile Estates, 9Router, Loopback Routing, SQLite Kanban
- Full-Stack AI & Engineering: Python, TypeScript, NestJS, React, PostgreSQL, Docker, AWS EC2, Linux VPS, systemd
- Machine Learning & Deep Learning: scikit-learn, LightGBM, XGBoost, Optuna, LoRA / PEFT, PyTorch
- Business Intelligence & Modeling: Microsoft Power BI (PL-300 certified), DAX, Star Schema, ETL
- Quantitative Research: OLS regression, chi-square, Kruskal-Wallis, class imbalance modeling

## AI Agent Systems Case Studies
- Multi-Agent Operations Platform: https://krishnendu.me/work/multi-agent-platform/
  Production multi-agent platform on Hermes Agent across 12 isolated domain profiles, 31 scheduled jobs, loopback proxy model routing, and kanban task orchestration.
- Model Routing and Tiered Compute: https://krishnendu.me/work/model-routing-tiered-compute/
  Loopback 9Router proxy routing across Claude Code CLI, Gemini 2.5 Pro, and Groq with fallback recovery and cost-optimized latency.
- Memory and Self-Documentation Systems: https://krishnendu.me/work/memory-self-documentation/
  Two-tier memory architecture with declarative fact stores and 341 modular skill manuals, validated by an automated markdown guard tool.
- Reliability, Offsite Recovery & Vault Security: https://krishnendu.me/work/reliability-security/
  Hourly configuration drift audits, encrypted GPG offsite backup capsules, and locked-down secrets handling on private Linux VPS.
- Automated Finance Ledger Agent: https://krishnendu.me/work/finance-ledger-agent/
  Automated receipt ingestion pipeline parsing digital receipts from read-only Gmail to a self-hosted Firefly III ledger with deterministic idempotency.
- Personal LinkedIn Studio: https://krishnendu.me/work/linkedin-studio/
  Local web studio for drafting structured posts with calibrated voice profiles, 34-pattern humanizer auditing, and strict human publication gates.

## Data and Machine Learning Case Studies
- QualityKiosk Estimation Platform: https://krishnendu.me/work/qualitykiosk-estimation-platform/
  Monorepo platform scoring 349 banking processes across 11 domains with RMS complexity and 136 unit tests.
- Smart MCQ Solver: https://krishnendu.me/work/smart-mcq-solver-lora/
  LoRA fine-tuning on DeBERTa-v3 and RoBERTa, achieving 0.74242 MAP@3 on 500 test questions.
- Multi-Class Comment Classification: https://krishnendu.me/work/comment-classification/
  Feature engineering and 100-trial Optuna study raising F1-Macro from 0.6221 to 0.8293 on 198K comments.
- Customer Exit Prediction: https://krishnendu.me/work/customer-exit-prediction/
  Systematic benchmark of 8 classifiers over 90,000 records, achieving 0.6365 validation F1.

  3-page Power BI dashboard with 7 DAX measures and 50,000-row star schema.
